core_obligations: Compute the global sections of the base changed module by flat base change, and observe that the images of generators of the global sections of F generate the global sections of the base change (proof lines 4211-4219).
Reduce the statement to the surjectivity of the evaluation map from a direct sum of copies of the structure sheaf onto F, using the chosen generators (proof lines 4220-4223).

proof_roadmap: Flat base change on global sections (proof lines 4211-4219).

Reduce to faithfully flat descent for module surjectivity (proof lines 4224-4229).
difficulty_reason: For a morphism X to Spec(A), a faithfully flat ring map A contained in A' and a quasi-coherent module F on X, the lemma shows that F is globally generated exactly when its base change to A' is (statement lines 4202-4208). The proof starts from flat base change: the global sections of the base changed module are the tensor product of the global sections of F with A' over A, so chosen generators of the sections upstairs come from generators downstairs (proof lines 4211-4219). The statement then becomes the surjectivity of the evaluation map from a direct sum of copies of the structure sheaf onto F, and this is reduced to an affine chart where the map corresponds to a map of B-modules; surjectivity there is equivalent to surjectivity after base changing along the faithfully flat map A to A' (proof lines 4220-4229). The claim is H2: one base change computation plus the standard faithfully flat criterion for surjectivity of a module map, with every reduction carried out explicitly.
